extraction.method: A single SIFT/RANSAC similarity transform registers extracted AI alpha to the original scan. AI alpha supplies ownership only; original source RGB is never warped, resized, strengthened or redrawn. Native continuous closed-form edge matting and foreground decontamination are solved in overlapping bounded tiles; exact original RGB is retained at opaque pixels. Original/white/dark visual review is required; alpha ownership remains approximate.

native_refinement.method: Original registered native alpha retained for the three gold trefoils and connected scroll. The native source input is expanded below/right, and the source-visible narrow terminal is restored up to its actual junction with the broader capital S using inspected native contour ownership and a continuous closed-form 8-pixel uncertainty band. Original RGB is unwarped, unresized and unchanged at opaque pixels. No hidden tip or new ornament is painted; larger glyph, counter grounds and separate pale dots remain excluded.

extraction.tool: Original native scan / closed-form edge alpha and foreground decontamination
extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Select only the small independent internal ornament: the serpentine golden scroll joining the THREE small golden trefoil blossoms within the upper blue/rose counter. Keep all three blossoms, their small stems, every complete spiral and the fine pale outlines belonging to this scroll. Remove the much broader golden capital-S stroke bordering the region at top/bottom/outer sides, the blue and rose counter grounds, and the separate pale background dots. This is the internal floral frieze, not the letter. Where the small scroll meets the larger glyph, retain the original visible ornament end without completing hidden or nonexistent branches. Preserve the connected scroll as one ornament, rather than presenting three separate trefoils. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.

retained_generated_ownership_guide.purpose: Retained AI alpha guide only; delivered opaque RGB belongs to the unchanged native source.

review.notes: Original source, complete page, expanded right-terminal source detail and white/dark native proof inspected. All three trefoils and the connecting gold scroll are intact, with native original opaque gilding RGB. Expanded input preserves the actual thin stem through its visible contact with the capital, without inventing hidden continuation. Broader glyph strokes, blue/rose counter grounds and independent pale dots are excluded. Finite ornament only; no source-established repeat or faithful vector is inferred.

assets.usage_notes: Finite connected gold scroll with three trefoil flowers extracted from the decorative counter of a capital S. The actual thin terminal is retained up to its visible junction with the broader glyph, without reconstructing hidden continuation. Alphabet strokes, blue/rose grounds and independent pale dots are excluded. Native gilding/paint RGB and source proportions are retained; no repeat or vector approximation is inferred.
